Inlined UsageCard rendering preserves the web visual contract: 3 at-a-glance bands with intent-tinted rings (normal = white/0.03, warn = warningSurface+warningBorder, danger = dangerSurface+dangerBorder, mirroring intentBandRing), a 2-column detail grid (md:grid-cols-4 collapses to the mobile 2-col layout) with intent-coloured values (normal/textPrimary, warn/warning, danger/danger, mirroring intentValueText), and stacked top-list blocks with a header glyph+uppercase title and truncated (numberOfLines=1) item labels + right-aligned values. The web font-mono on top-list labels is approximated by the default font (documented deviation); the budget/banner/footer UsageCard sections are intentionally omitted because this card never passes them.

No DOM elements, lucide-react, react-router-dom, @/ aliases, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI imports leak into native output; only react (useMemo/ReactNode), RN View/StyleSheet, the native AppText, theme tokens, and the already-ported useAiUsage/useSettings parity hooks are used.
